### “Yes, fine, I agree. Do it.” Nothing happened

> “Your account shows a zero balance with nothing past due.”

The agent read the address on file correctly, asked whether to turn paperless billing on, and the caller said “Yes, fine, I agree. Do it.” The trace holds three tool calls: two verifications and one account lookup. set_paperless_billing was never among them. The closing line is wrong too: this account owes $229.41 and it is overdue. get_account reports arrears on bills only, and the agent read that $0 back without checking the arrangement.
